report_metadata.title: False NON-PLANT IMAGE Rejection Fix Report
report_metadata.summary: Identified and fixed the root causes of false NON-PLANT IMAGE rejections on eggplant/brinjal plant and fruit images across Safeguard A (image_validator / plant_detector) and Safeguard B (open_set_crop_guard). Verified full separation of valid plant, uncertain crop, and genuine non-plant states across all test suites, live API, and frontend.

safeguard_a_image_validator.skin_mask_tissue_erasure: Necrotic lesions and fruit rots (e.g., Phomopsis rot on eggplant in imgi_121_2.phomopsis1.jpg) exhibit tan, brown, and dark yellow tones that satisfy R > G > B, Cr in [133, 173], Cb in [77, 127] in YCrCb space. Blind skin_mask subtraction erased 99% of plant lesion pixels, causing tissue coverage to fall below min_coverage (0.005 / 0.5%) and falsely triggering reason_code='non_plant_image'.
safeguard_a_image_validator.vegetative_gating_flaw: Fruit and flower detection rules (warm_fruit, berry_fruit, cool_flower) were conditionally gated on 'if veg_coverage > 0.002:'. Macro close-ups of harvested or hanging fruits lacking green leaves had veg_coverage = 0, causing the detector to skip all fruit analysis.
safeguard_a_image_validator.missing_purple_hue: Eggplant / brinjal purple and violet fruit hues (HSV H in [125, 165]) were missing from the detector, failing dark purple fruit validation.

safeguard_b_open_set_crop_guard.similarity_conflation: When Model 1 confidence was not decisive (< 0.85 or margin < 0.50), any prototype similarity < 0.50 unconditionally returned reason_code='non_plant_image', predicted_crop='Non-Plant Image'.
safeguard_b_open_set_crop_guard.low_crop_confidence_flaw: Low crop confidence or organ variance (fruit vs leaf) was conflated with 'absence of a plant'. Genuine plants with novel lesion morphology or organ variance (proto_sim in [0.25, 0.45]) were falsely condemned as non-plant images.

app/backend/image_validator.py: Ungated warm_fruit, berry_fruit, cool_flower, and purple_fruit from veg_coverage so fruit close-ups without green foliage pass.
Removed destructive YCrCb skin_mask subtraction from plant tissues; human presence is strictly and reliably handled by detect_human_face_presence().
model1_test_app/plant_detector.py: Synchronized purple_fruit HSV detection and ungated fruit/flower evaluation.
Removed skin_mask subtraction from plant tissue mask.
app/backend/open_set_crop_guard.py: Introduced NON_PLANT_DEEP_SIM_THRESHOLD = 0.22; only embeddings with prototype similarity < 0.22 across all classes can be declared non_plant_image.
Calibrated CROP_MIN_PROTO_SIM_ACCEPTED = 0.45 and CROP_MIN_PROTO_SIM_UNCERTAIN = 0.30 across all organ-variant and fruit-bearing crops.

Cleanly separated outcomes: Valid Plant (accepted, diagnosed), Uncertain Crop (safely flagged with farmer guidance, never labeled non-plant), and Genuine Non-Plant (rejected with reason_code='non_plant_image').

scripts/test_non_plant_rejection_regress.details: Verified eggplant phomopsis fruit rot, eggplant cercospora leaf, tomato fruit, ambiguous plant (uncertain_crop), genuine non-plant (solid color), genuine non-plant (random noise), and human selfie rejection.

scripts/test_safeguards.py.details: All unit tests for plant detection, face rejection, and boundary conditions passed.

scripts/test_crop_compatibility_regressi.details: All crop disease compatibility matrices and alias resolution passed.

scripts/test_crop_aware_inference_regres.details: All crop-aware Model 1 + Model 2 routing passed.

scripts/test_video_pipeline_regression.p.details: Video frame extraction, aggregation, and inference pipeline passed.

scripts/test_disease_source_links.py.details: All 151 disease classes across all 36 crops validated for authoritative source links.

case_1_eggplant_phomopsis_fruit_rot.verdict: FALSE REJECTION RESOLVED - CORRECTLY ACCEPTED AND DIAGNOSED

case_3_ambiguous_leaf.message: Crop identity could not be determined reliably. Please upload a clearer image showing distinctive leaves, flowers, or fruit.
case_3_ambiguous_leaf.verdict: DISTINCT UNCERTAIN OUTCOME - NEVER WRONGLY LABELED NON-PLANT

case_4_genuine_non_plant.message: This image does not appear to contain a plant. Please upload a clear plant image.

frontend_browser_verification.ui_result: Crop identified as Eggplant, disease diagnosed as Phomopsis fruit rot (~99% confidence), zero non-plant rejections triggered.

remaining_limitations: Extreme macro close-ups of isolated lesion spots that lack any visible fruit curvature, stem, or foliage context may yield low prototype similarity (< 0.30) and will be handled safely as 'Uncertain Crop' rather than producing an ungrounded disease diagnosis.
Completely black/underexposed purple fruits with HSV Value < 12 fall below darkness limits and require standard ambient lighting.
rollback_procedure: 1. Revert changes to app/backend/image_validator.py, model1_test_app/plant_detector.py, and app/backend/open_set_crop_guard.py.
2. Restart the uvicorn backend service: python -m uvicorn app.backend.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000.
3. Run scripts/test_safeguards.py to confirm baseline state restored.
